items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: And the great catcher, Josh Gibson, and all the guys that they're naming today, which is, uh, late in life they've named these great people.

ctx.x: Well, those are the baseball teams in the days that I'm talking about. They're both Crescent Starks Park, and that's where the main, uh, baseball games were played, even when they brought the, uh, the big stars down, like the Chicago Giants. And, of course, they picked up a few of the ball players from around here. Jumbo Jackson was one. And, uh, Satchel Page was down here. He's pitched down here. And the great catcher, Josh Gibson, and all the guys that they're naming today, which is, uh, late in life they've…
You said you were in the studio, you told him. Right.

Yeah, he was down there with the Pelicans. Well, yes, with the white Pelicans. The white Pelicans. Sure. So, but that other Jackson. Jumbo Jackson. There was another guy in town. So, they had a lot of teams coming in.

A lot of teams, a lot of great ball players. If they were living today, or if they could have captured them in those days. Josh Gibson was there. Satchel Caves. And all the other great ball players, Narco, N-R-P-E-L-B. And most of them used to go with the Giants.
Did you ever see the famous Brooks?
